entries.title: The Hex

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Hex is sourced as a Windows, Mac, and Linux desktop release; Windows PC is the preferred capture/input route for its genre-hopping metafiction structure.
primary.how_to_play: Buy The Hex on Steam for Windows PC and play the current desktop release.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or expanded definitive edition is documented.
